prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” attorney for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, and priorities (trial experience, maximum recovery, speed, language needs, etc.). I can help you find strong options, but first here’s a quick guide so you can choose an attorney who’s right for you.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: handled car-accident claims, similar injury severity, and experience in Cook County courts.
- Trial experience: more important if the insurer is likely to refuse a fair settlement.
- Track record: settlements/verdicts and peer ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers).
- Contingency-fee arrangement: most PI attorneys take cases on contingency (commonly 33%–40%), so you pay only if they recover money.
- Communication and team: who will actually handle the file (attorney or paralegal), how often you’ll get updates.
- Medical‑liens handling: experience resolving liens from hospitals, Medicare, Medicaid, or health insurers.
- Client reviews and complaints: Google/Yelp/BBB and state bar disciplinary records.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?
- Who will handle my case day‑to‑day?
- What is your fee and what other costs might I owe?
- How long do you expect this will take?
- Will you take my case to trial if needed?
- How do you handle medical liens and subrogation?

Where to check reputations
- Illinois State Bar Association / Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission
- Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers
- Local trial lawyer associations (Illinois Trial Lawyers Association)
- Online client reviews (Google, Yelp) — read several, not just one

Typical timeline and fees (rough)
- Most car-accident cases settle within months to a few years depending on injuries and complexity.
- Contingency fees usually 33% for settled cases (may be higher if suit filed or trial), plus case costs. Confirm in writing.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 well‑regarded Chicago personal injury attorneys or firms tailored to your zip code and case details, or
- Draft a short list of questions you can use for consultations.

If you’d like recommendations, tell me: your ZIP code, date of crash, whether you were injured and how badly, whether fault is disputed, and whether you’ve already spoken to an insurer.
